Title: Full unstake immediately after unlock
How to test: Wait until the position's lock-end timestamp passes, open the position, click "Unstake", approve in Phantom
Expected Result: Transaction confirms
column5: principal plus any due rewards are returned to the wallet

Title: Full unstake well after unlock (delayed, not immediate)
How to test: Let an unlocked position sit unclaimed/un-unstaked for a while, then unstake it
Expected Result: Unstake still succeeds and pays out the correct amount per the reward spec (verify whether rewards keep accruing past unlock or freeze at unlock — behavior must match design, not just "seems fine")

Title: Sequential unstake of multiple independent positions
How to test: Create 3+ independent positions from one wallet, unstake them one after another (A, then B, then C)
Expected Result: Each unstake is independent
column5: unstaking one position does not affect the balance, lock timer, or existence of the others

Title: Unstake right at the unlock boundary (script/rapid retry near the exact timestamp)
How to test: Attempt unstake at, just before, and just after the on-chain unlock timestamp (e.g. loop-retry near the boundary)
Expected Result: Unstake is rejected strictly before the unlock timestamp and accepted at/after it — no off-by-one gap or premature acceptance

Title: Attempt unstake 1 second before unlock
How to test: With a position whose lock is about to end, attempt unstake slightly early
Expected Result: Action is blocked by the UI and rejected on-chain if attempted directly

Title: Lock countdown shown in UI matches on-chain unlock timestamp
How to test: Compare the UI's displayed "unlocks in ..." countdown against the on-chain lock-end value read directly from the position account
Expected Result: Values match
column5: UI does not show "unlocked" before the program would actually accept the unstake (no client-side drift)

Title: Device clock manipulation does not affect lock/unlock state
How to test: Change the local device clock forward or backward by several days, then check the lock/unlock state and try to unstake
Expected Result: State and enforcement are based on on-chain Clock, not the device's system time — changing the device clock has no effect

Title: Attempt to unstake an already-closed/fully-unstaked position
How to test: Fully unstake a position, then try to trigger "Unstake" on it again (e.g. via a stale UI tab, browser back button, or resubmitting the same request)
Expected Result: Clear error is shown ("position not found"/"already closed")

Title: Attempt unstake with insufficient SOL for the network fee
How to test: Drain the wallet's SOL down to (near) zero, keep MEX staked, attempt unstake
Expected Result: Transaction fails gracefully with an insufficient-funds-for-fee style error
column5: the position remains staked and intact

Title: Attempt unstake while wallet session/connection is lost mid-flow
How to test: Disconnect/lock Phantom after opening the unstake confirmation dialog but before signing, then try to proceed
Expected Result: UI prompts to reconnect
column5: no transaction is submitted without a valid connected signer

Title: Confirm whether partial unstake is supported, and test accordingly
How to test: Check PRD/spec and UI for a partial-unstake option
Expected Result: if present, unstake less than the full staked amount and verify the remainder stays staked correctly
column5: if absent, confirm no hidden instruction path allows partial withdrawal with inconsistent state
column6: If partial unstake is supported, the remaining balance keeps accruing correctly under its original lock/tier
column7: if not supported, no partial-withdrawal path exists that could desync UI and on-chain state

Title: Submit unstake instruction for a position PDA owned by another wallet (IDOR)
How to test: Copy an unstake request from the Network tab, replace the position account with another (victim) wallet's known position PDA, sign as the attacker, submit directly
Expected Result: Program rejects the instruction (signer is not the authority/owner on that position account)

Title: Redirect unstake payout to an attacker-controlled destination account
How to test: Modify the intercepted unstake transaction's destination token account to an ATA that does not belong to the position's owner, then submit
Expected Result: Program validates the destination account against the owner's associated token account and rejects the mismatched destination

Title: Bypass the UI's locked/disabled unstake button via a raw instruction
How to test: While a position is still inside its lock window, copy the unstake request structure from Network tab and submit it directly (bypassing the disabled UI control)
Expected Result: Program rejects the unstake based on the on-chain lock-end check, independent of what the UI would allow to be built

Title: Pass a manually-derived, wrong-seed PDA as the position account
How to test: Craft an unstake instruction referencing a PDA that is syntactically valid but not derived from the correct seeds/bump for that position, submit it
Expected Result: Program's account validation rejects the mismatched PDA

Title: Replay a previously confirmed unstake transaction
How to test: Resubmit the exact same fully-signed unstake transaction (same signature, same blockhash) after it has already been confirmed
Expected Result: Second submission is rejected as already processed

Title: Attempt unstake using a stale/expired blockhash
How to test: Build and sign an unstake transaction, wait past the blockhash validity window (~60-90s), then submit
Expected Result: Submission fails due to expired/not-found blockhash rather than executing with stale context

Title: Race two unstake requests on the same position
How to test: Trigger "Unstake" on the same position twice in quick succession (two browser tabs or a rapid double-click bypassing any UI debounce)
Expected Result: Only the first request succeeds
column5: the second fails because the position account no longer exists/has no funds — no double withdrawal

Title: Race unstake and claim on the same position
How to test: Simultaneously trigger "Unstake" and "Claim" on the same position (two tabs, near-simultaneous submission)
Expected Result: Requests resolve consistently — rewards are neither paid out twice nor silently lost between the two operations

Title: Race unstake and check-in at the moment of unlock
How to test: At the exact moment a position unlocks, simultaneously attempt a check-in and an unstake
Expected Result: Both resolve in a well-defined, consistent order per the on-chain logic
column5: no state is left where streak/rewards are corrupted or duplicated

Title: Atomicity when unstake bundles auto-compound-at-unlock in the same transaction
How to test: Force a failure partway through a combined unstake+auto-compound transaction (e.g. insufficient rent for a newly required account) and observe the result
Expected Result: The entire transaction fails and rolls back as a unit
column5: there is no partial state where compounding happened but the transfer/close did not (or vice versa)

Title: Network fee is charged even when the unstake instruction is rejected
How to test: Attempt an unstake that is expected to be rejected on-chain (e.g. raw instruction sent before unlock), inspect the fee payer's SOL balance before/after
Expected Result: Behavior is verified and documented: either the fee is charged despite instruction failure (typical for on-chain program errors) or the request fails at simulation before broadcast (no fee) — confirm which applies here and that it matches user-facing messaging

Title: Compute budget is sufficient for unstake with many pending reward computations
How to test: Let a position accrue rewards across many check-in/tier changes, then unstake it and inspect compute units consumed on a devnet explorer
Expected Result: Transaction confirms without exceeding the compute unit limit, or the app explicitly requests additional compute budget via `ComputeBudgetProgram` and still stays within protocol limits

Title: Position PDA account is closed and rent refunded on full unstake
How to test: Fully unstake a position and inspect the position PDA's account status and the recipient's SOL balance change on a devnet explorer
Expected Result: The position account is closed
column5: its rent-exempt lamports are refunded to the correct party (staker or fee payer, per design) beyond the network fee

Title: Wallet's MEX associated token account is not closed by unstake
How to test: Unstake a position fully, then check whether the wallet's MEX ATA still exists and is reusable
Expected Result: The ATA persists after unstake (only the position account should close) so future stakes don't need to re-pay ATA rent

Title: Closing one position's account does not affect sibling positions
How to test: With 2+ independent positions open, fully unstake one of them and check the others
Expected Result: The remaining positions' balances, lock timers, and accounts are completely unaffected

Title: Unstake behavior when the pool/program is paused by admin multisig (if a pause mechanism exists)
How to test: If a Squads-controlled pause exists, have the multisig pause the program, then attempt to unstake a position
Expected Result: Unstake is either explicitly blocked with a clear error (if pause covers withdrawals) or explicitly still allowed (if pause only affects new stakes) — confirm which is the intended behavior and that it's enforced on-chain, not just in the UI

Title: Unstake resumes correctly after an admin multisig unpause (if applicable)
How to test: After confirming pause blocks unstake (previous case), have the multisig execute an unpause action, then retry the same unstake
Expected Result: Previously blocked unstake now succeeds without requiring the user to do anything beyond retrying

Title: Unstake a position with pending unclaimed rewards
How to test: Let rewards accrue without claiming, then unstake the position directly (without a separate claim first)
Expected Result: Pending rewards are auto-settled per design (claimed/compounded as part of unstake) — verify they are not silently forfeited

Title: Unstake a position with zero pending rewards (already fully claimed)
How to test: Claim all pending rewards on a position, then immediately unstake it
Expected Result: Only the principal is returned
column5: the zero-reward edge case does not produce an error or unexpected zero-amount transfer issue

Title: Final payout reflects time-weighted tier progression, not a retroactive final tier
How to test: Progress a position through multiple check-in tiers over time (primary/secondary rate changes), then unstake and compare the total payout to a manual calculation based on the time actually spent at each tier
Expected Result: Reward calculation uses the tier rate that was active during each accrual period, not the tier reached at the moment of unstake

Title: Unstake confirmation dialog shows an accurate principal/reward breakdown before signing
How to test: Open the unstake confirmation modal for a position with known principal and accrued rewards
Expected Result: Displayed amounts (principal, rewards, total) match what is actually transferred once the transaction confirms

Title: Rejecting the wallet signature popup during unstake leaves a clean state
How to test: Start an unstake flow, but click "Reject" in the Phantom signature popup instead of approving
Expected Result: UI returns cleanly to the pre-unstake state
column6: there is no stuck loading spinner or inconsistent partial UI state

Title: Unstake button state matches fresh on-chain data after a hard reload
How to test: Reload the page (hard refresh, clearing any client cache) right at/near a position's unlock boundary and check the unstake control's enabled/disabled state
Expected Result: State is derived from a fresh on-chain query and matches reality, not a stale cached client-side timer

Title: Position list updates immediately after a successful unstake
How to test: Complete an unstake and observe the "My Positions" list without manually refreshing the page
Expected Result: The unstaked position disappears (or is marked closed) immediately after transaction confirmation

Title: Wallet balance updates immediately after a successful unstake
How to test: Complete an unstake and observe the displayed MEX balance without manually refreshing the page
Expected Result: The balance reflects the newly returned principal/rewards immediately after confirmation

Title: Clear error is shown for non-lock-related unstake failures
How to test: Simulate or trigger a non-lock unstake failure (e.g. network congestion, RPC timeout, simulation failure) and observe the UI's response
Expected Result: A clear, specific error message is shown to the user
column5: the failure is not silent and is distinguishable from a "still locked" rejection
